scope: V2 research and high-signal alert qualification only; no V1, PAPER/LIVE order or safety-gate edits

price_basis.regular_session: ETF movement from 09:30 America/New_York first regular-session open to latest completed five-minute bar close, 09:35-16:00 ET
price_basis.extended_session: ETF movement from preceding completed 15:55-16:00 ET regular-session closing bar to latest completed SIP or BOATS extended-hours bar close, or next opening gap
price_basis.crossover: Regular-session 09:30 bar begins new daytime reference; extended-hours uses previous RTH close
price_basis.missing_data: fail closed; do not conflate unobserved 20:00-04:00 BOATS with zero movement

event_policy.raw_touch: research observation only, no Pushover and no order
event_policy.qualified_alert: requires at least 2 consecutive COMPLETED five-minute ETF closes on same directional side of the threshold, fresh two-of-three peer breadth where three peers available or both peers in two-peer sectors, verified holiday/session/quote freshness; do not claim predictive emergency without independently validated post-signal continuation
event_policy.existing_stock_emergency: 2.5% total drop from preceding completed regular close INCLUDING at least 1.0 percentage point in preceding 15 minutes; maintain independent factual warning

histogram_source: Alpaca SIP five-minute trade-bar 52-week split adjusted, completed history through Nov6 2026; not full BOATS during 20:00-04:00
status: DECLARATIVE V2 POLICY, pending separately commissioned all-sector observer and broker-safe release; ChatGPT tasks may use this threshold for filtering, not for self-execution
